description: WP-O5 Codex: Orks (11e) MORGOG'S FINKIN' CAP (Brute Bosses enhancement, Warboss model; once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if this model's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, roll one D6: this unit can make a normal move of up to that many inches; if riled up you can re-roll the D6). Fixture ork11e_enh_brute_enemy_move: P2 (Custodes) is active. A real click on End Movement Phase (P2) opens the movement_phase_end windows; P1's shows the 0-CP enhancement card; a real click on 'Use on Warboss' rolls the D6 and the Warboss's reactive normal move of up to that many inches begins (the riled-up re-roll variant is headless); a real 6-inch drag moves it up to the rolled cap (the move is held to the D6 result) and 'End This Unit's Move' completes it; the remaining (Custodes) cards are declined and the phase ends. The AI declines this enhancement (headless).

steps.comment: P2's own movement_phase_end cards (if any) are declined
the reacting player (P1) decides at the end of the opponent's Movement phase
not riled up: the Warboss makes a normal move of up to the D6 result

steps.script:
var cap := float(PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance()._ork11e_reactive_move.get("max_inches", 0.0))
print("[wp-o5] Morgog's Finkin' Cap cap ", cap)
GameState.state.meta["_o5_cap"] = cap
return cap >= 1.0 and cap <= 6.0
steps.comment: the D6 result is the move cap

steps.script:
var moved := (689.0 - float(GameState.get_unit("U_WARBOSS_A").models[0].position.y)) / 40.0
var cap := float(GameState.state.meta["_o5_cap"])
print("[wp-o5] Morgog moved ", moved, " of ", cap)
return moved > 0.8 and moved <= cap + 0.05 and moved >= minf(cap, 6.0) - 0.3
steps.comment: the Warboss moved as far as dragged, but never beyond the rolled cap (a 6" drag is held to the D6 result)
the opponent's Movement phase ends once the remaining windows are answered
